name: contract-check-resource-budget
goal: Run checks within the admitted parent budget and use two GiB for standalone verification

evidence: CheckRunService.execute requests no memory amount, so the resource schema assigns 512 MiB even when its admitted caller reserved two GiB. Nested normal build/check scripts request 2048 MiB and exceed that smaller child lease. Verify needs a bounded inherited budget rather than the hidden 512 default.

The existing runner diagnostics cases assert statuses, retained errors and case results but never inspect the child resource budget. The canonical run/initialized case will retain those assertions and assert that its real disposable Node child receives the parent memory allocation, or the project standalone default. Preserve the method case after adoption; no standalone bug test.
